question: Should CodexBar expose an opt-in setting that lets one valid claude-swap account replace the ambient Claude presentation, despite a sentinel-only row also taking that precedence once enabled?
rationale: Current behavior and documentation intentionally preserve ambient presentation for zero or one account; accepting the new setting changes that established product boundary rather than repairing a defined defect.

options.title: Accept the explicit opt-in
options.body: Keep the default-off setting and require live proof that one account, zero accounts, and explicit CLI overrides behave as documented.

options.title: Keep the multi-account boundary
options.body: Decline the setting and preserve the current rule that only two or more claude-swap accounts replace ambient presentation.

recommendation.title: Accept the explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Keep the default-off setting and require live proof that one account, zero accounts, and explicit CLI overrides behave as documented.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership and the user-visible configuration decision make this the strongest available routing candidate.
